Hi Samir — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few open items so we can get to a pilot SOW and procurement path:

- Procurement flow: you mentioned Acme typically does PO for purchases over $50k and card for smaller purchases. Can you confirm the internal threshold and whether Finance will accept Net-30 invoicing?
- Marketplace: there was interest in AWS Marketplace, but procurement needs to confirm whether that route is required for internal approvals. Can you check?
- Budget / signatory: who is the economic buyer, who is the finance sponsor, and who signs contracts (CFO or delegated signatory)? Please include name, title, and best email.

Next steps from our side: I will share a one-page pilot SOW and our PO instructions. Vivek (cc'd) will handle commercial/contract questions and can provide standard PO/invoice wording.

Attachments: SOW_template.docx (draft), Redwood_PO_instructions.pdf (stub)

Thanks Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. A few answers and items from our side:

- PO threshold: Correct — Acme requires a PO for purchases above $50k. For amounts below that, we generally use the corporate card. We can do Net-30 for contracted work but need that reflected on the invoice.
- Marketplace: We are interested in AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement, but Procurement needs to know whether Redwood will accept Marketplace billing (procurement asked for confirmation).
- Budget/Signatory: Economic buyer for this pilot is Alexandra Ramos (Director, Search & AI) — alex.ramos@acmecorp.com. Finance sponsor is Jonathan Keene, VP Finance (jonathan.keene@acmecorp.com). Final signatory is the CFO or delegated approver — I'll confirm the name if needed, but we usually have Jonathan sign for pilots under $250k.

Can you send the SOW and PO instructions to procurement@acmecorp.com so they can start routing? Also include an example invoice if possible.

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, Acme Corp
samir.patel@acmecorp.com | +1 617-555-0199
